run_interactive_image_generation_task: run the mephisto interactive image generation task locally using the inhouse blueprint and operator
get_next_fieldset_remote_procedure: get the next dynamic fieldset config for an interactive image generation task based on worker prompt and score
request_image_url_simulation: simulate retrieval of a generated image URL from a third-party service using a prompt and answer index
generate_data_json_config: generate an extrapolated task_data.json config file from form and token sets values config files
cache_unit_fieldset_history: track and append fieldset prompt and score history per unit using the UnitSafeCacheService
